content_record.title: Mitochondria: the shared engine failure in aging, HIV, and long COVID
content_record.editorial_body: A unified mitochondrial perspective reveals overlapping mechanisms—oxidative stress, impaired mitophagy, mtDNA damage—and points to organelle-level therapies. Three things to remember - Mitochondrial dysfunction links aging, HIV, and long COVID. - Oxidative stress and impaired mitophagy drive energy failure. - Mitochondrial transfer and mtDNA correction show early promise. Source This signal is based on Mitochondrial Dysfunction in Aging, HIV, and Long COVID: Mechanisms and Therapeutic Opportunities. from PubMed. Read the original report for full context. Health note: Hypothesis/review; therapies are preclinical, not clinically proven.
